items.text: The update releases on PC shortly before the start of Season 2 on October 16.
🔗 http://discord.gg/nba2k
Shooting

Fixed "ghost contests" where defenders who weren't truly contesting still hurt the shot. Contests now properly factor in defender position at release and require defenders to be more squarely in front of the shooter.

Shooting has been fine-tuned to better reward good shot selection. Open shots from quality shooters are more effective, mid-range gets a boost in competitive modes, and overall three-point percentages have been slightly rebalanced.
Improved how shot range is determined for several shooting badges, resulting in more accurate badge activation.
Improved missed shot rebounds by reducing multiple rim bounces, reducing near-out-of-bounds results, and fixing a leftward bounce bias.
Reduced missed dunks when Dunk Timing is turned off.
Fixed an issue where dunks and alley-oops could be missed even with correct timing on the dunk meter.
Contact dunks succeed more often at every badge level of Rise Up.

Tuned several Takeovers: Shot Artist, Calibrated, and Navigator have adjusted timing windows, Navigator and Airspace make defense matter more, and Airspace and Detonator reduce dunk frequency and success. Rim Guardian now counters Airspace.
Bad Shot Selection event no longer triggers incorrectly on greened layups and dunks or decent mid and 3PT shot attempts.

Improved passing and catching, including fewer missed catches and collisions with defenders, better pass responsiveness in a body-up, and slightly faster pass speeds. Also fixed the inbounder being incorrectly called for out of bounds after an inbound pass.
Steal animations are now better matched to the stealer's rating, and low-rated or out-of-adrenaline defenders are properly penalized on failed attempts.

CPU defenders now play looser on-ball and off-ball defense at the start of the game. Once a player starts scoring, the AI will eventually defend them with a higher intensity. We will continue to monitor the effects of AI intensity behavior on human players.
Fixed an issue where Behind-the-Back Escape commands would randomly result in a standard behind-the-back dribble.
Fixed an exploit where pressing down on the D-pad to perform a dribble emote could cancel a sprint into an unnaturally fast stop.
Fixed an issue where spamming the self-lob input while posting up could allow users to travel in the post in 1v1 gameplay.
Tightened the requirements for anklebreakers so only hard decelerations and quick launches qualify.
Fixed multiple free throw and shooting foul issues, including incorrect free throw counts, misattributed putbacks, fouls on uninvolved defenders, and a rare unresponsive state.
Reduced the frequency of shooting fouls on blocked shots.
The indicator showing who your opponent is controlling is now visible in online team control modes.
Fixed several Shot Meter and HUD issues, including the Shot Meter being hidden behind the Team Communication Status icon and flipping sides mid-shot.
Many improvements to stability, visuals, and functionality to enhance the overall experience in The City.
Shorts length can now be customized for REC/Proving Grounds/Crews uniforms when in an Eras save.
Shorts length can now be properly modified for female MyPLAYERs.
Various updates have been made to Spectator mode to streamline the experience.
The “Play as a Squad in a Multiplayer Game” Daily Challenge can now be properly completed.
Resolved a user-reported delay that could occur when swapping a build while in a squad.
Players will no longer be unexpectedly removed from the locker room when the system UI is kept up for too long.
Resolved a hang when losing connection while joining a Squad.
Players will no longer be removed from a squad when accepting an existing invite after joining the friend manually.
Crew Divisions match difficulty has been adjusted to match current REC settings (Squad Showdown kiosk games will remain on previous settings).
Shot Meters have been enabled for Crew Divisions (and Event Center) matches.
Crew Divisions matches now earn 25% more REP. Increase your Crew’s level for even higher bonuses.
Crew Divisions matches now earn 2X CXP for all games played to help your Crews level up even faster.
Added the ability to view postgame menus and replays for Crew Divisions and Squad Showdown matches.
Gatorade and Skill Boosts will no longer be consumed in Squad Showdown kiosk matches.
Fixed an issue preventing some Crews from getting multiple Squad Showdown kiosk matches started at the same time.
Jerseys will now properly unequip after finishing Crew games.
Crew Challenges will now be correctly completed if the crew was first joined via the NBA 2K HQ app.
Resolved a connection error when accepting a squad invite while on the Crew HQ practice court.
Fixed incoming Crew invites temporarily disappearing when a player cancels their own outgoing invite request to the same crew.
Fixed a potential hang when using the ball machine in Crew HQ.
Fixed the defensive shading indicator's orientation being flipped 180 degrees in some Ante-Up and Theater games.
Improved the court lighting near the edge of the building in the Ante-Up venue.
Addressed a hang when leaving a Park via invite or lost connection while waiting at the Server Change kiosk.
The correct Geo Rank will now appear for your opponent during player introductions in Park games.
Fixed an issue preventing some Street Kings co-op games from being started.
Resolved a potential disconnect when attempting to play Starting 5 games.
Fixed a rare issue in The REC that could prevent games from being started properly when traveling in a squad.
Fixed a disconnect when playing games in MyCOURT with the Unlimited Stamina option turned on.
Fixed an issue preventing play from continuing in MyCOURT when players are warming up before starting a game of 21.
Social
Fixed an issue with the Social menu UI that could cause the wrong player to be selected.
Online friends not currently playing NBA 2K27 will no longer show in the Social menu as doing so.
The Search option will now function correctly when adding a 2K Friend from the Social menu while finding a match in the Event Center.
MyCAREER Eras saves will now transition across eras, allowing for a full 25-year NBA career.
Many additional improvements have been made to the Eras experience to ensure expected player movement, proper progression, and accurate Moments tracking.
Multiple fixes and adjustments have been made to improve the general quest experience and ensure proper progression and objective completion.
Multiple fixes and adjustments have been made to improve tracking, objective completion, and reward earnings in Challenges.
Rebirth, MyPOINTS Accelerator, Workout Warrior, GOAT Skills, and other special quests can now start progressing again if userdata had been previously corrupted or lost.
Several fixes have been made to Endorsement objectives to ensure proper progression and rewarding.
Custom shoe designs are now properly saved and displayed in menus and associated billboards.
The "Win 6 Championships in 6 Playoff Appearances" Career GOAT Moment can now be properly completed.
The Lifetime Challenge for answering 2KTV questions will now be correctly incremented when answering them via the Main Menu.
Various fixes and updates have been made to the Fire & Concrete story to enhance the overall experience.
Resolved a progression blocker that could occur after Chapter 3.
The "Fire and Concrete" trophy will now properly unlock when meeting the conditions.
The Recap screen now shows individual event values that were missing after certain Fire & Concrete games.
Fixed a possible loss of functionality when attempting to initiate On-The-Fly Coaching when Trace Miller is not on the court.
The Draft Projection menu will now display the correct position when MP is the consensus #1 pick.
Various fixes have been made to improve stability and progression in MyCAREER Co-Op matches.
Guest players will no longer be switched to the bench camera when the host player is switched to it.
GOAT Skill Accolade quests that were incorrectly marked complete following Co-Op games will now proceed as expected.
Various updates have been made to the Attributes, Badges, Takeover, and Build Specialization menus to make them more informative.
The requirements for tiers 7 and 9 of the Physicals Build Specialization track have been lowered based on community feedback.
Badge Accelerators and clearer endorsement progression are now shown on postgame Recap screens for easier reference.
Fixed a rare hang that could occur when simulating during the playoffs several seasons in the future.
Resolved a hang that could occur in MyCOURT when transitioning to the offseason via the Play Next Game menu.
Teammates standing off the court can now be challenged to 1v1 games in the Team Practice Facility.
Fixed a reported hang in the Team Practice Facility when starting a 5v5 drill immediately after a 1v1 teammate challenge.
Seasonal animations now have their own filter in the Animation Store for easy identification.
Clothing presets will no longer be overwritten when viewing them with a mascot or body mod equipped.
Custom hair colors will no longer revert to the default color when attempting to edit them in the MyPLAYER Appearance menu.
Nose and eyebrow piercings will now be properly removed when accessories are toggled off in the MyPLAYER Appearance menu.
Clothing items worn out of the store will now remain equipped when the game is relaunched.
Various updates and enhancements to the UI have been made across all modes to improve the overall experience.
Resolved an issue that could cause select local save data to become corrupted when uninstalling and reinstalling the game.
Arena security guards will no longer be visible when the Draw Security Guard option is turned off in Instant Replay Settings.
The UI can now properly be hidden while in the gameplay camera in Instant Replay.
The Friends Leaderboard now populates correctly in Play Now Online.
Added the missing Post Hop Step Tendency and Driving Layup Tendency ratings to the menu.
You can no longer switch to a new team when invalid rotation minutes have been set.
When importing/exporting Player DNA, items new to 2K27 will now be correctly included.
Stanchion padding colors have been updated for accuracy in several historic arenas.
The sideline scorer’s table color in the Los Angeles Lakers arena has been updated for accuracy.
The Division Champions banner for the Milwaukee Bucks has been updated.
The 2021 championship banner has been added to the Chicago Sky arena.
The jumbotron for the Phoenix Mercury has been updated.
The jumbotron for the Portland Fire has been updated.
The multi-championship commemorative banner has been added to the Seattle Storm arena.
The 2019 championship banner has been added to the Washington Mystics arena.

Menu performance when scrolling search results has been improved.
Unowned player cards can now be added or removed from your Wishlist in auction search results.
Your collection can now be searched for auctionable cards via an empty My Auctions menu.
Fixed hangs that could occur while navigating auction search results or when sending a won card to collections that result in a collection reward.
The buttons to replace coach cards and to go to the Coach’s Training Challenges menu have been swapped.
You must now replace your active head coach card before quickselling, exchanging, or sending it to the Auction House.
Addressed rare issues with starting Coach’s Training Challenges for player cards.
Ensured the “Take Over” achievement/trophy properly unlocks from specific flows.
Addressed an issue preventing some lineups from being able to play Showdown games.
Prevented ‘blank’ Limited Time Modes from appearing in the Play Tab after they expire.
The View/Edit Player menu will now update available Parallels immediately when earned from Player XP rewards.
Resolved an issue where a Player Card could be added multiple times to the same Exhibition Mission.
Available player counts in Gauntlet will update immediately after obtaining rewards in the store.
WNBA team autofill options will now respect Gauntlet-selected players.
WNBA Tempo and Fire team filters have been added in locations they were missing.
Player Cards will no longer receive a different visual OVR on the My Collection menu when adding or removing favorite cards.
Favorite Plays have been fixed to apply when your MyTEAM is the home team.
Updated Player Card visuals in cases where Parallels or the unowned grayed-out state would cause issues.
Addressed other rare hangs that could occur in the Shoe Lab, Lineups, Duplicates menus, and Triple Threat Park.

Various other visual and functionality improvements to the Auction House, My Collection, Limited Time Events, Lineups, Play Tab, Pack Market, REP, Shoe Lab, Training Hub, View/Edit Player menu, and in-game presentation overlays.
‘Goals’ – Rerolls the selected Dynamic Goal Challenge
‘2X REP’ – Activates double REP for the selected amount of time for all modes in MyTEAM
Added a new Redeem Prizes button to the Play Tab, when Challenge-based prizes are available.
When active, Coach’s Training Challenges & Dynamic Goals will now appear in their own row in the Play Tab.
Added The Exchange to the Triple Threat Park & All-Star Team-Up NAV menus.
Updated the Player XP progress bar to reset with each level.
A confirmation overlay has been added before merging Parallels from the Duplicates menu.
Ineligible slots will appear with a lock when accessing The Exchange from the Duplicates menu.
The daily ‘Hot Start’ Takeover Challenge can now be completed in Triple Threat modes.
Added Challenge group titles and descriptions to reward pop-ups.
Removed player cards used for opponent lineups from unowned search results in My Collection.
Text is now properly aligned when looking at Dynamic Duo Boosts.
In Gauntlet runs, unavailable players will no longer appear by default when replacing players in a lineup.
Added the amount of time players will be unavailable while on Exhibition Missions before they begin.
Various stability fixes and improvements have been made for MyNBA, MyNBA Online, and The W.
Ensured that the simulator and created prospects are utilizing new badges appropriately.
Shooting tendencies will now progress at a more realistic rate for star players.
Pace has been increased for simulated games, increasing shot attempts and related stats to more expected levels.
Adjusted the Voter Fatigue and Tough Critics Challenge Modifiers in MyNBA Legacy to make winning the MVP and Defensive Player of the Year awards more realistically achievable.
Fixed a rare hang at the start of a season if a player-to-avoid signing via a contract promise has retired.
Proposed rule changes can now be added and removed during offseason league meetings.
Players added from the Draft Board will now be properly removed when loading a new Draft Class in the Prospect Scouting menu.
Fixed an issue causing events after the Draft Lottery to incorrectly auto-simulate when turning the Eliminate the Draft Lottery rule on.
Fixed a loss of control on an inbound in a scrimmage game after viewing Player Highlight Reels in the Highlight Builder.
Addressed an issue in MyGM preventing certain players on the roster from being available to trigger a queued conversation in the Team Practice Facility.
Injuries can no longer be removed via the Injury Report screen in MyNBA Legacy Ranked mode.
Fixed an issue preventing advancement to the next season in MyNBA Lite when using Create/Edit Draft Class in the offseason.
Resolved a rare hang when saving custom team branding after having previously played for an extended period.
Fixed a hang when overriding the NBA Cup MVP winner from the Awards menu.
Fixed a hang when navigating away from a Custom lineup in the On The Fly Lineups screen when not enough players have been selected.
Resolved a hang that could occur when attempting to use SimCast following a timeout.
Fixed a hang during an expansion draft if no more players are available to pick.
Fixed a hang that could occur when attempting to Simulate with SimCast from the G-League Daily View during the NBA Cup.
The home team in NBA Cup knockout games now correctly wear their Statement jerseys.
Staff badge editing and the ability to unretire jersey numbers are now restricted to admins/co-admins in MyNBA Online.
Resolved a hang in The W when reloading a save if the game had been previously exited during a press conference.
Badge progression will now display properly on the Choose Drills menu in The W.
PlayVision has been re-enabled in Practice Plays in The W.
Ensured that the Second Chance and Post Presence badges trigger as expected in The W.
Added Advanced Shader Delivery support to download per-driver shaders from the cloud and significantly decrease install time.
Supported on the following graphics cards, with the latest Windows 11 version and latest drivers required:
NVIDIA RTX 20 series or later (after the next driver release)
AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT or later
Intel Arc B series or later
The Intel Xe Low Latency setting is now properly disabled when turned off in the Video Settings menu.
The visual quality of the Eras filters has been significantly improved on Steam Deck.
The best way to share your thoughts on NBA 2K is through the #game-report-issue and #game-suggestions channels in our Discord, and the seasonal Community Surveys in-game.
We’re always monitoring these channels and appreciate everyone who takes the time to share constructive feedback.
